units.literal: When An Lushan rebelled, because Feng Changqing and Gao Xianzhi had been defeated and lost, the emperor summoned Han and appointed him Vanguard Commander of the Heir Apparent's Army; Tian Liangqiu was made Censor-in-Chief and Campaigning Major; Wang Sili, Qian'er Dafu, Li Chengguang, Su Fading, Guan Chongsi, and barbarian generals Huoba Guiren, Li Wuding, Hun E, Qibi Ning, and others were made deputy generals — Hexi, Longyou, Shuofang troops and barbarian soldiers together with Gao Xianzhi's old troops, two hundred thousand in all, to resist the rebels at Tong Pass.

units.zh: 其將王思禮、李承光又爭長不葉，人無鬥志。
units.en: Generals Wang Sili and Li Chengguang vied for command and would not cooperate — the men lost heart.
units.literal: His generals Wang Sili and Li Chengguang also vied for precedence and would not cooperate — men had no fighting spirit.

units.zh: 元載以罪誅，除揆睦州刺史，入拜國子祭酒、禮部尚書，為盧杞所惡。
units.en: After Yuan Zai was executed for his crimes, Kui was appointed prefect of Muzhou. He later entered court as Director of the Directorate of Education and Minister of Rites, but Lu Qi bore him ill will.
units.literal: When Yuan Zai was executed for crime, Kui was appointed prefect of Muzhou; he entered court as Director of the Directorate of Education and Minister of Rites, but was hated by Lu Qi.

units.zh: 冕以幸臣李輔國權盛，將附之，乃表輔國親昵術士中書舍人劉烜充山陵使判官。
units.en: Because the favored minister Li Fuguo's power was great and Mian meant to attach himself to him, he memorialized that Fuguo's close associate, the diviner and drafting secretary Liu Xuan, serve as aide to the tomb-guard commissioner.
units.literal: Mian, because favored minister Li Fuguo's power was great and intending to attach himself to him, submitted a memorial that Fuguo's close associate, the diviner and Drafting Secretary Liu Xuan, serve as aide to the tomb-guard commissioner.

units.zh: 代宗求舊，拜冕兼御史大夫，充護山陵使。
units.en: Daizong looked to men of long service and appointed Mian concurrently censor-in-chief and commissioner for guarding the imperial tombs.
units.literal: Daizong sought out veterans of former service and appointed Mian concurrently Censor-in-Chief and Commissioner for Guarding the Imperial Tombs.

units.zh: 江西節度使嗣曹王臯為前軍兵馬使，鄂嶽團練使李兼為之副。
units.en: Li Gao, the Prince of Cao and military commissioner of Jiangxi, was appointed front-army commander, with Li Jian, regimental commissioner of E and Yue, as his deputy.
units.literal: Li Gao, Prince of Cao and military commissioner of Jiangxi, was made front-army commander; Li Jian, regimental commissioner of E and Yue, was his deputy.

units.zh: 宦官魚朝恩為觀軍容使，鎮陜州，與之昵狎。
units.en: The eunuch Yu Chao'en, army-observing commissioner at Shaanzhou, favored him.
units.literal: The eunuch Yu Chao'en was army-observing commissioner, garrisoned Shaanzhou, and was intimate with him.

units.zh: 朝恩以扈從功，恩渥崇厚，奏請多允，屢於上前賞拔智光，累遷華州刺史、同華二州節度使及潼關防禦使，加檢校工部尚書、兼御史大夫，
units.en: Chao'en's escort service won him favor; he praised Zhiguang again and again before the throne. Zhiguang rose to Governor of Hua, military governor of Tong and Hua, Tong Pass defender, and Acting Minister of Works with concurrent Censor-in-Chief.
units.literal: Chao'en for escort merit received thick favor; his requests were mostly granted; he repeatedly praised Zhiguang before the throne; Zhiguang was promoted repeatedly to Governor of Huazhou, military governor of Tong and Hua, defense commissioner of Tong Pass, and Acting Minister of Works with concurrent Censor-in-Chief,

units.zh: 袁高，字公頤，恕己之孫。
units.en: Yuan Gao, courtesy name Gongyi, was the grandson of Shuji.
units.literal: Yuan Gao, courtesy name Gongyi, was the grandson of Shuji.

units.zh: 太子少保韋倫、太府卿張獻恭等奏：「袁高所奏至當，高是陛下一良臣，望加優異。」
units.en: Junior Mentor of the Heir Apparent Wei Lun, Minister of the Imperial Treasury Zhang Xiangong, and others submitted, 'Yuan Gao's memorial was entirely right. Gao is a good minister of Your Majesty. I hope he may receive special favor.'
units.literal: Junior Mentor of the Heir Apparent Wei Lun, Minister of the Imperial Treasury Zhang Xiangong, and others submitted: 'Yuan Gao's memorial was entirely appropriate; Gao is a good minister of Your Majesty—I hope he may receive special favor.'

units.zh: 登進士第，累辟使府，有贊佐裨益之譽。
units.en: He passed the jinshi examination and was repeatedly recruited to commissioner staffs, with a reputation for effective assistance.
units.literal: He passed the jinshi examination and was repeatedly recruited to commissioner offices, with a reputation for beneficial assistance.

units.zh: 代宗登極，征入朝，累官至給事中、御史中丞。
units.en: When Daizong ascended the throne, Gao was summoned to court and rose to Drafting Attendant and Censor-in-Chief.
units.literal: When Daizong ascended the throne, he was summoned to court and rose through offices to Drafting Attendant and Censor-in-Chief.

units.zh: 以論事失旨，貶韶州長史，復拜為給事中。
units.en: His remonstrance displeased the throne and he was demoted to senior administrator of Shaozhou, then reappointed Drafting Attendant.
units.literal: For remonstrance that missed the emperor's intent he was demoted to senior administrator of Shaozhou and later reappointed Drafting Attendant.

units.zh: 貞元元年，德宗復用吉州長史盧杞為饒州刺史，令高草詔書。
units.en: In Zhenyuan 1 Dezong again appointed Lu Qi, former senior administrator of Jizhou, prefect of Raozhou and ordered Gao to draft the edict.
units.literal: In the first year of Zhenyuan, Dezong again employed Lu Qi, senior administrator of Jizhou, as prefect of Raozhou and ordered Gao to draft the edict.

units.zh: 少慷慨，慕名節。
units.en: In youth he was generous and aspired to integrity and renown.
units.literal: In youth he was generous and aspired to fame and integrity.

units.zh: 建中二年，擢為京畿觀察使。
units.en: In Jianzhong 2 he was promoted to commissioner observing the capital region.
units.literal: In the second year of Jianzhong he was promoted to observation commissioner of the capital region.

units.zh: 高執詞頭以謁宰相盧翰、劉從一曰：「盧杞作相三年，矯詐陰賊，退斥忠良。
units.en: Gao took the draft and called on chancellors Lu Han and Liu Congyi, saying, 'Lu Qi served as chancellor for three years, deceitful, treacherous, and secretive, driving away the loyal.
units.literal: Gao took the draft text and called on chancellors Lu Han and Liu Congyi, saying: 'Lu Qi served as chancellor for three years, deceitful, treacherous, and secretive, driving away the loyal and good.

units.zh: 朋附者咳唾立至青雲、睚眥者顧盼已擠溝壑。
units.en: His followers rose to the clouds with a cough; those who crossed him were pushed into the ditch with a glance.
units.literal: Those who joined his faction reached the clouds with a cough or spit; those who crossed him with a glance were already pushed into ditches.

units.zh: 傲很明德，反易天常，播越鑾輿，瘡痍天下，皆杞之為也。
units.en: Arrogant toward virtue, he reversed Heaven's order, drove the emperor into exile, and scarred the realm—all was Qi's doing.
units.literal: Arrogant toward bright virtue, he reversed Heaven's constants, drove the imperial carriage into exile, and scarred all under Heaven—all was Qi's doing.

units.zh: 爰免族戮，雖示貶黜，尋已稍遷近地，若更授大郡，恐失天下之望。
units.en: He was spared clan extermination and though demoted, was soon moved nearer the capital. If a great prefecture is granted now, I fear you will lose the hope of the realm.
units.literal: He was spared clan extermination and though shown demotion, he was soon moved somewhat nearer; if a great commandery is now granted, I fear the hope of all under Heaven will be lost.

units.zh: 惟相公執奏之，事尚可救。」
units.en: Only if you chancellors firmly memorialize can the matter still be saved.'
units.literal: Only if the chancellors firmly memorialize can the matter still be saved.'

units.zh: 翰、從一不悅，改命舍人草之。
units.en: Han and Congyi were displeased and had an attendant draft the edict instead.
units.literal: Han and Congyi were displeased and changed the order, having an attendant draft it instead.

units.zh: 詔出，執之不下，仍上奏曰：「盧杞為政，窮極兇惡。
units.en: When the edict was issued, he held it and refused to promulgate it, submitting further: 'Lu Qi's governance was utterly vicious and evil.
units.literal: When the edict was issued, he held it and would not promulgate it, still submitting: 'Lu Qi's governance reached the utmost in vicious evil.

units.zh: 三軍將校，願食其肉；
units.en: Officers of the three armies wished to eat his flesh;
units.literal: Officers of the three armies wished to eat his flesh;

units.zh: 百辟卿士，嫉之若讎。」
units.en: the hundred ministers hated him as an enemy.'
units.literal: the hundred ministers hated him as an enemy.'

units.zh: 高又於正殿奏云：「陛下用盧杞獨秉鈞軸，前後三年，棄斥忠良，附下罔上，使陛下越在草莽，皆杞之過。
units.en: Gao again addressed the throne in the main hall: 'Your Majesty employed Lu Qi alone as chancellor for three years, casting out the loyal, currying favor below and deceiving above, and driving Your Majesty into exile—all Qi's fault.
units.literal: Gao again submitted in the main hall: 'Your Majesty employed Lu Qi alone to hold the scales of power for three years, casting out the loyal and good, currying favor below and deceiving above, causing Your Majesty to wander in the wilds—all Qi's fault.

units.zh: 且漢時三光失序，雨旱不時，皆宰相請罪，小者免官，大者刑戮。
units.en: In Han times, when the heavens fell out of order and rain and drought came untimely, chancellors pleaded guilty—minor faults meant removal, major faults meant execution.
units.literal: Moreover, in Han times when the three luminaries lost order and rain and drought came untimely, chancellors all pleaded guilty—minor cases meant removal from office, major cases meant execution.

units.zh: 杞罪合至死，陛下好生惡殺，赦杞萬死，唯貶新州司馬，旋復遷移。
units.en: Qi's crime deserved death. Your Majesty loves life and hates killing and pardoned him from death, demoting him only to militia commander of Xinzhou, yet soon moved him again.
units.literal: Qi's crime deserved death; Your Majesty loves life and hates killing and pardoned him from ten thousand deaths, only demoting him to militia commander of Xinzhou, yet soon moved him again.

units.zh: 今除刺史，是失天下之望。
units.en: Appointing him prefect now would lose the hope of the realm.
units.literal: Now appointing him prefect is to lose the hope of all under Heaven.

units.zh: 伏惟聖意裁擇。」
units.en: I beg Your Majesty to decide.'
units.literal: I prostrate myself in hope that Your sagely intent will decide.'

units.zh: 「盧杞奸臣，常懷詭詐，非是不逮。」
units.en: "Lu Qi was a treacherous minister who constantly harbored deceit. It was not a matter of falling short."
units.literal: "Lu Qi is a treacherous minister who constantly harbored deceit—it was not a matter of falling short."

units.zh: 高曰：「赦乃赦其罪，不宜授刺史。
units.en: Gao said, 'An amnesty pardons crime. He should not be made prefect.
units.literal: Gao said: 'An amnesty pardons crime; he should not be made prefect.

units.zh: 且赦文至優黎民，今饒州大郡，若命奸臣作牧，是一州蒼生，獨受其弊。
units.en: The amnesty was most generous to the people. Raozhou is a great prefecture. If a traitor is made its governor, the people of that province alone will suffer.
units.literal: Moreover, the amnesty text was most generous to the black-haired people; Raozhou is a great commandery—if a treacherous minister is made its shepherd, the common people of one province alone will suffer the harm.

units.zh: 望引常參官顧問，並擇謹厚中官，令采聽於眾。
units.en: I beg that regular-attendance officials be consulted and careful inner attendants chosen to gather opinion from the people.
units.literal: I hope regular-attendance officials may be consulted and careful, solid inner attendants chosen to gather and hear from the multitude.

units.zh: 若億兆之人異臣之言，臣當萬死。」
units.en: If the people disagree with me, I deserve ten thousand deaths.'
units.literal: If the hundred million people differ from your subject's words, your subject deserves ten thousand deaths.'

units.zh: 於是，諫官爭論於上前，上良久謂曰：「若與盧杞刺史太優，與上佐可乎？」
units.en: Thereupon remonstrance officials argued before the throne. After a long silence the emperor said, 'If prefect is too generous, would senior administrator suffice?'
units.literal: Thereupon remonstrance officials argued before the throne; after a long while the emperor said: 'If making Lu Qi prefect is too generous, would making him senior administrator suffice?'

units.zh: 曰：「可矣！」
units.en: They said, 'That will do!'
units.literal: They said: 'That will do!'

units.zh: 遂追饒州制。
units.en: The Raozhou appointment was then recalled.
units.literal: The Raozhou appointment edict was then recalled.

units.zh: 翌日，遣使宣慰高云：「朕思卿言深理切，當依卿所奏。」
units.en: The next day an envoy was sent to comfort Gao, saying, 'I have reflected on your words. They are profound and urgent. I shall follow what you submitted.'
units.literal: The next day an envoy was sent to comfort Gao, saying: 'I have reflected on your words—they are profound in principle and urgent in point; I shall follow what you submitted.'

units.zh: 復奏曰；
units.en: Gao submitted again:
units.literal: He submitted again:

units.zh: 及討淮西，判度支楊於陵坐饋餫不繼貶，以司農卿皇甫鎛代之，由是益為刻剝。
units.en: Campaigning against Huai-Xi, Yang Yuling was demoted for supply failures; Huangfu Bo replaced him and extraction grew crueler.
units.literal: When the Huai-Xi campaign began, Yang Yuling, acting director of revenue, was demoted for failure to keep supplies flowing; the Minister of Agriculture Huangfu Bo replaced him, and from this extraction grew harsher.

units.zh: 陳少遊，博州人也。
units.en: Chen Shaoyou was a native of Bozhou.
units.literal: Chen Shaoyou was a native of Bozhou.

units.zh: 父慶，右武衛兵曹參軍，以少遊累贈工部尚書。
units.en: His father Qing had been a military staff officer of the Right Martial Guards; because of Shaoyou he was repeatedly posthumously made Minister of Public Works.
units.literal: His father Qing was a military staff officer of the Right Martial Guards; because of Shaoyou he was repeatedly posthumously made Minister of Public Works.

units.zh: 少遊幼聰辯，初習《莊》、《列》、《老子》，為崇玄館學生，眾推引講經。
units.en: Shaoyou was clever and eloquent as a youth. He first studied the Zhuangzi, Liezi, and Laozi, entered the Chongxuan Hall as a student, and his fellows recommended him to lecture on the classics.
units.literal: Shaoyou was clever and eloquent in youth; he first studied the Zhuangzi, Liezi, and Laozi, became a student of the Chongxuan Hall, and the crowd recommended him to expound the classics.

units.zh: 秀遽曰：「中丞美才，不當遠官，請從容旬日，冀竭蹇分。」
units.en: Xiu said hastily, "Vice Censor, your talent is too fine for a distant post. Give me ten days or so; I hope to do what little I can."
units.literal: Xiu said hastily: "Vice Censor, your talent is too fine for a distant post. Please allow ten days or so; I hope to do my poor utmost."

units.zh: 既擢第，補渝州南平令，理甚有聲。
units.en: After passing the examination he was appointed magistrate of Nanping in Yuzhou, where his governance won wide renown.
units.literal: After he passed the examination he was appointed magistrate of Nanping in Yuzhou, and his governance won great renown.

units.zh: 至德中，河東節度王思禮奏為參謀，累授大理司直、監察殿中侍御史、節度判官。
units.en: In the Zhide era Wang Sili, military commissioner of Hedong, recommended him as staff adviser. He rose through appointments as rectifier in the Court of Judicial Review, investigating palace censor, and military commissioner aide.
units.literal: In the Zhide era Wang Sili, military commissioner of Hedong, memorialized that he be made staff adviser; he was repeatedly appointed rectifier in the Court of Judicial Review, investigating palace censor, and military commissioner aide.

units.zh: 寶應元年，入為金部員外郎。
units.en: In the first year of Baoying he entered court as outer office director in the Ministry of Revenue.
units.literal: In the first year of Baoying he entered court as outer office director in the Ministry of Revenue.

units.zh: 無幾，澤潞節度使李抱玉表為副使、御史中丞、陳鄭二州留後。
units.en: Before long Li Baoyu, military commissioner of Zelu, recommended him as deputy commissioner, Censor-in-chief, and acting governor of Chen and Zheng.
units.literal: Before long Li Baoyu, military commissioner of Zelu, memorialized that he be made deputy commissioner, Censor-in-chief, and acting governor of Chen and Zheng.

units.zh: 遷晉州刺史，改同州刺史，未視事，又歷晉、鄭二州刺史。
units.en: He was made prefect of Jinzhou, then reassigned to Tongzhou. Before he could take up that post he served again as prefect of Jin and Zheng.
units.literal: He was transferred to prefect of Jinzhou, then changed to prefect of Tongzhou; before taking office he again served as prefect of Jin and Zheng.

units.zh: 其年，除桂州刺史、桂管觀察使。
units.en: That year he was appointed prefect of Guizhou and observation commissioner of the Gui circuit.
units.literal: That year he was appointed prefect of Guizhou and observation commissioner of the Gui circuit.

units.zh: 秀、載內外引薦，數日，拜宣州刺史、宣歙池都團練觀察使。
units.en: With recommendations from Xiu within the palace and Zai outside it, within a few days he was appointed prefect of Xuanzhou and overall training-and-defense and observation commissioner of Xuan, She, and Chi.
units.literal: Xiu and Zai recommended him inside and outside court; within a few days he was appointed prefect of Xuanzhou and overall training-and-defense and observation commissioner of Xuan, She, and Chi.

units.zh: 及會，少遊攝齊升坐，音韻清辯，觀者屬目。
units.en: When the day came, Shaoyou gathered his robes and ascended the seat. His voice was clear and his argument keen, and every eye in the hall was on him.
units.literal: When the meeting came, Shaoyou gathered his robes and ascended the seat; his tones were clear and his argument keen, and the onlookers fixed their eyes on him.

units.zh: 祖儼，安西副都護。
units.en: His grandfather Yan had served as Vice Protector-general of Anxi.
units.literal: His grandfather Yan was Vice Protector-general of Anxi.

units.zh: 明年，仆固懷恩奏為河北副元帥判官、兵部郎中、兼侍御史。
units.en: The following year Pugu Huai'en recommended him as aide to the deputy commander-in-chief of Hebei, bureau director in the Ministry of War, and concurrent attendant censor.
units.literal: The next year Pugu Huai'en memorialized that he be made aide to the deputy commander-in-chief of Hebei, bureau director in the Ministry of War, and concurrent attendant censor.

units.zh: 永泰二年，抱玉又奏為隴右行軍司馬，拜檢校左庶子，依前兼中丞。
units.en: In the second year of Yongtai, Baoyu again recommended him as marching army vice marshal of Longyou and acting Left Guardian of the Heir Apparent, while retaining his concurrent post as Censor-in-chief.
units.literal: In the second year of Yongtai, Baoyu again memorialized that he be made marching army vice marshal of Longyou, appointed acting Left Guardian of the Heir Apparent, and as before concurrently Censor-in-chief.

units.zh: 所引文句，悉兼他義，諸生不能對，甚為大學士陳希烈所嘆賞，又以同宗，遇之甚厚。
units.en: Every passage he cited carried additional meanings, and the students could not answer him. Grand Academician Chen Xilie greatly admired him, and because they shared the same surname clan, treated him with exceptional favor.
units.literal: The passages he cited all carried additional meanings; the students could not reply, and Grand Academician Chen Xilie greatly admired him; moreover, being of the same clan, he treated him very generously.

units.zh: 尋授侍御史、迥紇糧料使，改檢校職方員外郎。
units.en: Soon he was made attendant censor and grain-supply commissioner for the Uyghurs, and was reassigned as acting outer office director in the Ministry of War.
units.literal: Soon he was made attendant censor and grain-supply commissioner for the Uyghurs, and was changed to acting outer office director in the Ministry of War.

units.zh: 充使檢校郎官，自少遊始也。
units.en: The practice of appointing an envoy with acting courtier rank began with Shaoyou.
units.literal: Serving as envoy with acting courtier rank began with Shaoyou.

units.zh: 少遊為理，長於權變，時推幹濟，然厚斂財貨，交結權幸，以是頻獲遷擢。
units.en: In governing, Shaoyou was skilled at expedient adaptation and was praised for practical ability. Yet he levied heavy taxes, cultivated the powerful and favored at court, and thereby won frequent promotion.
units.literal: Shaoyou in governing was skilled in expedient adaptation; his contemporaries praised his practical ability, yet he heavily levied wealth and cultivated connections with the powerful and favored, and thereby frequently gained promotion.

units.zh: 少遊以嶺僥遐遠，欲規求近郡。
units.en: Shaoyou, finding the Ling region remote and arduous, set about securing a post nearer the capital.
units.literal: Shaoyou, because the Ling region was remote and perilous, wished to scheme for a nearer prefecture.

units.zh: 時中官董秀掌樞密用事，少遊乃宿於其裏，候其下直，際晚謁之，從容曰：「七郎家中人數幾何？
units.en: At that time the eunuch Dong Xiu controlled secret affairs and wielded great power. Shaoyou lodged in his lane, waited until he left duty, and at dusk called on him. Calmly he asked, "Seventh Brother, how large is your household?
units.literal: At that time the eunuch Dong Xiu controlled secret affairs and wielded power; Shaoyou lodged in his lane, waited until he left duty, and at dusk called on him, saying calmly: "Seventh Brother, how many people are in your household?

units.zh: 時少遊又已納賄於元載子仲武矣。
units.en: By then Shaoyou had also paid bribes to Yuan Zai's son Zhongwu.
units.literal: At that time Shaoyou had also paid bribes to Yuan Zai's son Zhongwu.

units.zh: 秀既逾於始望，欣愜頗甚，因與之厚相結。
units.en: Xiu, far beyond what he had first hoped for, was greatly pleased and formed a close bond with him.
units.literal: Xiu, exceeding his first hopes, was greatly pleased and formed a close bond with him.

units.zh: 每月所費復幾何？」
units.en: And how much do you spend each month?"
units.literal: How much do you spend each month?"

units.zh: 少遊曰：「據此之費，俸錢不足支數日，其餘常須數求外人，方可取濟。
units.en: Shaoyou said, "At that rate your salary would not last a few days. The rest must constantly be sought from outsiders before you can make ends meet.
units.literal: Shaoyou said: "By this reckoning your salary would not last a few days; the rest must constantly be sought from outsiders before you can make ends meet.

units.zh: 倘有輸誠供億者，但留心庇覆之，固易為力耳。
units.en: If someone offers you sincere support, you need only take him under your protection—it is easily done.
units.literal: If someone offers sincere support in supplying your needs, you need only take care to shelter him—it is easy enough to manage.

units.zh: 少遊雖不才，請以一身獨供七郎之費，每歲請獻錢五萬貫。
units.en: Though I lack talent, I ask to supply all of Seventh Brother's expenses myself, offering fifty thousand strings of cash each year.
units.literal: Though I am without talent, I ask to supply Seventh Brother's expenses alone myself, offering fifty thousand strings of cash each year.

units.zh: 今見有大半，請即受納，餘到官續送。
units.en: I have more than half of it on hand now—please accept it at once. The rest I will send once I take up my post.
units.literal: I now have more than half on hand—please accept it at once; the rest I will continue sending once I take office.

units.zh: 免貴人勞慮，不亦可乎？」
units.en: Would that not spare you worry?"
units.literal: Would it not spare a nobleman's anxieties?"

units.zh: 少遊言訖，泣曰：「南方炎瘴，深愴違辭，但恐不生還再睹顏色矣。」
units.en: When Shaoyou had finished he wept and said, "The southern heat and miasma grieve me deeply at this parting. I fear I shall not return alive to see you again."
units.literal: When Shaoyou finished speaking he wept and said: "The southern heat and miasma deeply grieve me at parting; I fear I shall not return alive to see your face again."

units.zh: 吉甫卒，裴度擢為刑部侍郎，俄知吏部選事。
units.en: After Jifu died, Pei Du promoted him to Vice Minister of Justice and soon put him in charge of personnel selection.
units.literal: When Jifu died, Pei Du promoted him to Vice Minister of Justice and soon had him oversee selection affairs in the Ministry of Personnel.

units.zh: 宰相楊炎遇之頗厚，召入左司郎中、京兆少尹，遷大尹。
units.en: Chief Minister Yang Yan treated him generously, brought him to court as bureau director in the Left Secretariat and junior magistrate of the capital district, and then promoted him to chief magistrate.
units.literal: Chief Minister Yang Yan treated him very generously, summoned him in as bureau director in the Left Secretariat and junior magistrate of the capital district, and promoted him to chief magistrate.

units.zh: 然暴橫少恩，杖前部尉以逞憾，觀察使王緯以聞，德宗不省。
units.en: Yet he was brutal and unforgiving: he had a former subordinate commandant flogged to settle a personal score. Observation commissioner Wang Wei reported it, but Emperor Dezong paid no heed.
units.literal: Yet he was violent and overbearing and short on kindness; he beat a former subordinate commandant to vent a grudge. Observation commissioner Wang Wei reported this, but Emperor Dezong took no notice.

units.zh: 帝晚務姑息，頔所奏建，無不開允。
units.en: In his later years the emperor favored appeasement, and every proposal Di submitted won approval.
units.literal: The emperor in his later years pursued indulgence and forbearance; whatever Di memorialized and proposed was invariably approved.

units.zh: 俄擅以兵取鄧州，天子未始誰何。
units.en: Before long he seized Dengzhou by force on his own authority, and the emperor never called him to account.
units.literal: Soon he on his own authority took Dengzhou by force, and the Son of Heaven never once held him to account.

units.zh: 智興能駛步，奉表，不數日至京師告急，德宗出朔方軍五千擊納，解去，自是為徐特將。
units.en: Zhixing could run at great speed; he carried a memorial and reached the capital within days to report the crisis. Dezong dispatched five thousand Shuofang troops against Na and lifted the siege; from then on Zhixing was a special general of Xuzhou.
units.literal: Zhixing could run swiftly; he bore a memorial and in only a few days reached the capital to report the emergency. Dezong sent out five thousand Shuofang troops to strike Na, and the siege was lifted; from then on he was a special general of Xuzhou.

units.zh: 德宗既厭兵，大抵刺史重代易，至歷年不徙。
units.en: After the emperor wearied of campaigning, prefects were usually turned over often—though some lingered in office for years on end.
units.literal: Once Emperor Dezong grew weary of warfare, for the most part prefects were frequently rotated, yet some went years without transfer.

units.zh: 德宗立，召還。
units.en: Dezong's accession brought his recall to court.
units.literal: When Emperor Dezong acceded, he was recalled.

units.zh: 復出，宰相李勉、盧翰、劉從一方同歸中書，中使馬欽緒至，揖從一，附耳語而退，諸相各歸閣。
units.en: Fu went out. Chief ministers Li Mian, Lu Han, and Liu Congyi together returned to the Secretariat. Palace envoy Ma Qinxu arrived, bowed to Liu Congyi, whispered in his ear, and withdrew. The ministers each returned to their offices.
units.literal: Fu went out; chief ministers Li Mian, Lu Han, and Liu Congyi together returned to the Secretariat; palace envoy Ma Qinxu arrived, bowed to Congyi, whispered in his ear, and withdrew; the ministers each returned to their offices.

units.zh: 今勉、翰不可在相位，即去之；
units.en: If Li Mian and Lu Han ought not be in chief minister posts, then remove them;
units.literal: If Mian and Han ought not be in chief minister posts, then remove them;

units.zh: 從一詣復曰：「適欽緒宣旨，令與公商量朝來所奏便進，勿令李勉、盧翰知。」
units.en: Liu Congyi went to Fu and said, "Just now Qinxu announced the imperial intent, ordering me to consult with you and immediately advance this morning's memorial. Do not let Li Mian and Lu Han know."
units.literal: Congyi went to Fu and said: 'Just now Qinxu announced the imperial intent, ordering me to consult with you and immediately advance this morning's memorial; do not let Li Mian and Lu Han know.'

units.zh: 希烈聞之大怒，即署其大將杜少誠為偽僕射、淮南節度，令先平壽州，後取廣陵。
units.en: Xilie was enraged and immediately appointed his great general Du Shaoqian false Vice Director and Huainan military commissioner, ordering him first to pacify Shouzhou and then take Guangling.
units.literal: Xilie heard this and was greatly enraged; he immediately appointed his great general Du Shaoqian false Vice Director and Huainan military commissioner, ordering him first to pacify Shouzhou and then take Guangling.

units.zh: 建封於霍丘堅柵，嚴加守禁，少誠竟不能進。
units.en: Jianfeng built strong palisades at Huoqiu and guarded them strictly; Shaoqian could not advance.
units.literal: Jianfeng built strong palisades at Huoqiu and strictly guarded them; Shaoqian in the end could not advance.

units.zh: 貞元二年，領蔡州節度大使、申光蔡觀察等使，以大將吳少誠為留後。
units.en: In Zhenyuan 2 (786), he was named military commissioner of Caizhou and observation commissioner for Shen, Guang, and Cai, with the great general Wu Shaocheng as deputy commissioner.
units.literal: In the second year of Zhenyuan, he took charge as military commissioner of Caizhou and observation commissioner for Shen, Guang, and Cai; the great general Wu Shaocheng was made deputy commissioner.
